channel.description: Latest articles from Amandla – Bias and Credibility (aidc.org.za)

item.title: AIDC Submission to Parliament on the Revised and Proposed Fiscal Framework - AIDC | Alternative Information & Development Centre
item.description: The AIDC proposes alternatives to austerity, including enhancing tax progressivity and addressing tax evasion to increase public sector funding.Read more ›

item.title: AIDC message of support to the AMCU National Congress - AIDC | Alternative Information & Development Centre
item.description: Over the years, AMCU and AIDC have deepened their collaboration in challenging the government’s neoliberal economic policies, which continue to entrench unemployment, inequality, and poverty. Read more ›

item.title: Bled Dry: The gendered impact of tax abuse, illicit financial flows and debt in Africa - AIDC | Alternative Information & Development Centre
item.description: In Bled Dry: How tax abuse, illicit financial flows and debt affect women and girls in Africa, we explore how tax abuse and illicit financial flows, and the resulting loss of public revenue, have pushed states towards regressive tax policies, debt, and austerity measures. Read more ›

item.title: AIDC is hiring: Administrative Officer & Logistics Coordinator - AIDC | Alternative Information & Development Centre
item.description: AIDC is seeking a highly organised, efficient, and dependable Administrative Officer & Logistics Coordinator. Read more ›

item.title: Budget Day 2026 Briefing Paper: HOW PENSION TAX BREAKS DEEPEN INEQUALITY - AIDC | Alternative Information & Development Centre
item.description: Despite being the most unequal country in the world, South Africa still has tax breaks that deepen inequality. In this briefing paper, we show how the retirement fund contribution deduction disproportionately benefits high-income earners. Read more ›

item.title: STATEMENT: AIDC calls for a decisive break with austerity - AIDC | Alternative Information & Development Centre
item.description: The Alternative Information and Development Centre (AIDC) rejects the 2026 National Budget as a continuation of austerity, liberalisation, and investor-friendly policymaking that prioritise capital over the lives and dignity of the working class and poor. Read more ›

item.title: Voices Rise Against Austerity on Budget Day 2026 - AIDC | Alternative Information & Development Centre
item.description: On Budget Day 2026, hundreds of people gathered outside Parliament to demand a change in South Africa’s priorities.Read more ›

item.title: FACTSHEET: Budget 2026 Explainer Series - AIDC | Alternative Information & Development Centre
item.description: The Budget 2026 Explainer Series aims to break down the key decisions in this year’s budget in clear and accessible language. This series unpacks what the budget really means for workers, unemployed people, women, communities, and public services.Read more ›

item.title: AIDC Submission to Parliament on the 2026 Fiscal Framework and Revenue Proposals - AIDC | Alternative Information & Development Centre
item.description: The Alternative Information & Development Centre (AIDC) argues that the proposed fiscal framework for the 2026 Budget may worsen poverty and unemployment in South Africa, which is the most unequal country in the world.Read more ›

item.title: Building Power From Below: Activists Unite to Defend the Right to Say No! - AIDC | Alternative Information & Development Centre
item.description: Today, we concluded an insightful two-day annual #RightToSayNo workshop, attended by over 50 activists representing mining-affected communities from various regions across the country. Read more ›
